prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: transparent production wardrobe wear masters for a desktop character
Input images: Images 1, 2, 3, 4 are the exact edit targets, respectively front, right three-quarter, right profile, back. Image 5 is supporting colour/material design reference only, specifically its MOON POST outfit.
Make a 2-by-2 transparent atlas in that same view order. Each cell is a separate complete copy of its corresponding target character, in the same neutral pose and camera scale, with ample transparent margins. Keep original character silhouette, long ear proportions, feet positions, cream body colour, dark brown outline weight, cheek hatching, eye positions/highlights and characteristic TWO connected upper-lip waves unchanged. Full profile keeps its original one visible eye. Do not turn this into another mascot or Dango.
Add one coherent moon-post outfit onto the targets: a compact lavender beret nestled at ear roots with a small cream crescent; a narrow soft cream/lavender star collar below the chin, well clear of the mouth; a short muted lavender cape with a few cream stars and a soft raised collar, opening at the front; a small rounded cream envelope satchel with a pink seal and believable shoulder strap entirely below the cheek; a shallow arc of three tiny gold/cream stars just above the ear tips; a single pair of soft lavender ankle boots fitted over the two existing feet, tiny cream crescent details, two soles total.
Preserve all six pieces across views and realistic back/side wrapping. Keep the cape short enough that the satchel and boots remain clearly visible. The bag hangs at the character's own left hip, changing visibility correctly by view; no bag attached to a cheek. The two boots face the same direction as the body, do not add spare feet. Keep the front opening of the cape and the bag separated so they can later become independent layers.
Style: match the supporting reference's warm quiet hand-drawn smooth contours, soft large colour planes, restrained material shading and round garment volume. Avoid coarse pixel edges, photorealism, excessive fabric texture, tiny dense stitching, glossy metal, strong body shading, or new body features. Keep the original body simple and flat; only garments have gentle material depth. It must remain readable as a small 99px-high character.
Transparent background with actual alpha. No checkerboard baked in, no floor, ground shadow, scenery, labels, text, cell borders, diagrams, or detached accessory icons. Do not crop any ears or star arc.
